notes_sections.title: Basic Concept of Speed, Time and Distance
notes_sections.content:
Speed means how much distance is covered in a given time.

Distance = Speed × Time
Speed = Distance ÷ Time
Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Example:
If a bike moves at 60 km/h for 2 hours,
Distance = 60 × 2 = 120 km.

notes_sections.title: Units of Time
notes_sections.content:
1 hour = 60 minutes
1 minute = 60 seconds

If speed is in km/h, time must be in hours.

Example:
30 minutes = 30/60 = 0.5 hours.

notes_sections.title: Constant Speed Problems
notes_sections.content:
If speed remains constant, distance increases directly with time.

Example:
If a car travels 50 km in 1 hour,
In 3 hours it will travel 50 × 3 = 150 km.

notes_sections.title: Important Formulas
notes_sections.content:
1. Distance = Speed × Time
2. Speed = Distance ÷ Time
3. Time = Distance ÷ Speed

DST Triangle Trick:
Write Distance on top, Speed and Time at the bottom.
Cover the value you need and apply multiplication or division.

notes_sections.title: Common Mistakes
notes_sections.content:
1. Not converting minutes into hours.
2. Mixing km and meters.
3. Using the wrong formula.

Always keep units consistent.

notes_sections.title: Quick Summary
notes_sections.content:
Distance = Speed × Time
Speed = Distance ÷ Time
Time = Distance ÷ Speed
Keep units correct before solving.

tricks.title: Convert Minutes to Hours Quickly
tricks.explanation: Divide minutes by 60 to convert into hours.

tricks.title: Double Speed, Half Time Rule
tricks.explanation: If distance is fixed and speed doubles, time becomes half.
tricks.example: 60 km at 30 km/h = 2 hours; at 60 km/h = 1 hour.

tricks.title: Half Speed, Double Time Rule
tricks.explanation: If speed becomes half, time becomes double (distance fixed).
tricks.example: 100 km at 50 km/h = 2 hours; at 25 km/h = 4 hours.

tricks.title: Find Distance First
tricks.explanation: If speed and time are given, calculate distance first.

tricks.title: Unit Check Trick
tricks.explanation: After solving, check whether the answer unit is correct.
tricks.example: If question asks distance, answer must be in km or meters.

tricks.title: Time from Distance Trick
tricks.explanation: When distance is simple multiple of speed, divide directly.

tricks.title: Keep Units Same
tricks.example: 500 meters = 0.5 km before using km/h speed.
